title: Validation catalog resource policies missing for simulation runtime live plans
description:
Expected: validation_catalog_integrity must pass for main and PR branches. Any plan with writes_business_state=true or production-adjacent MiniQMT/LocalSim simulation behavior must declare an explicit resource_policy, forbid prod_db unless specifically approved, include evidence_policy for L4/L5 plans, and default live/long-running L3+ plans to manual/non-runner-enabled unless gated.
Actual: GitHub PR #153 for BUG-096 failed Static gate (l0 + module registry) in validation_catalog_integrity. The failing report shows P0 RESOURCE-001 and RESOURCE-005 for miniqmt_sim_trading_hours_l5, plus P1 CATALOG-012/RESOURCE-006 findings for localsim_unattended_l3, miniqmt_sim_stub_l3, simulation_runtime_ops_ui, simulation_dual_backend_l4, and miniqmt_sim_trading_hours_l5. This blocks unrelated BUG-096 merge and indicates validation catalog resource safety metadata is incomplete.
closure_requirements: validation_catalog_integrity passes with no P0/P1 findings for simulation runtime plans
miniqmt_sim_trading_hours_l5 declares resource_policy and forbids prod_db unless explicitly approved
L3/live or long-running plans are not runner_enabled by default unless manual/nightly gated according to catalog rules
L4/L5 plans declare runtime timeout and evidence_policy
GitHub issue #156 and BUG JSON remain synchronized

events.note: Observed in GitHub Actions run 26280489478 for PR #153: validation_catalog_integrity state=failed with error_count=2 warning_count=5.
P0 findings: miniqmt_sim_trading_hours_l5 writes business state but lacks resource_policy; miniqmt_sim_trading_hours_l5 does not explicitly forbid prod_db.

P1 findings: L3/live plans localsim_unattended_l3, miniqmt_sim_stub_l3, simulation_runtime_ops_ui must not be runner_enabled by default; L4/L5 plans miniqmt_sim_trading_hours_l5 and simulation_dual_backend_l4 lack evidence_policy.
Fix must be in an independent worktree/branch and must not be mixed into BUG-096.
